history.summary: A 1,249 sqft freehold 3BR at Fortune Park (1996) in D19 Kovan at $1.85M ($1,481 PSF), 690m from Kovan NE13 MRT. Freehold and well-located, but the asking PSF runs ~11% above the project's own $1,339 URA median while the development is nearly 30 years old.
history.rating_rationale: At $1,481 PSF the listing sits ~11% above Fortune Park's $1,339 URA median — paying a premium on a 1996-built (30-year-old) freehold block whose resale CAGR is a modest ~3.5%/yr (15 txns). The very low score_1000 (361) flags poor relative value. Freehold + Kovan location are positives, but an aged development at an above-median price with mediocre appreciation is exactly the overpriced-old-asset profile to avoid for a 5-7yr investment hold.
red_flags: Asking $1,481 PSF is ~11% above the $1,339 URA median
catalysts: Established Kovan/Serangoon location, ~690m to NE13 MRT
